meta.name: Short Cut
meta.description: Design DNA extracted from the Short Cut Android app (mobile/src/theme.ts and the shipped screens) and the zed.dev marketing page, used to generate the Short Cut download site.

primary.role: Ink for headlines and primary type; the paper-and-ink base of the whole system.

secondary.role: Teal for informational accents, status dots and secondary links.

accent.role: Coral reserved for action: the route button, the download CTA, start/end route lines.

neutral.usage: Lightest surfaces (#FAFBF5) for cards that replace app sheets, #F0F2E9 for the page, #DCE2D4 for hairlines, #6D7D77 for supporting copy, #172B28 for type.

color.contrast_strategy: dark-on-light dominant, high contrast for type with low-contrast hairlines and one saturated coral action per view

typography.font_style_notes: Geometric grotesque for display with unusually tight tracking, paired with a humanist sans for reading. Two families only, both already shipped inside the app.

spacing.section_rhythm: large 128px section gaps on desktop, collapsing to 72px on mobile, with hairline rules used as the only division between major blocks

layout.grid_system: 12-column fluid grid with a 1200px content cap
layout.alignment_tendency: asymmetric on the hero and comparison panel, strictly left-aligned for prose

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px hairlines in #DCE2D4 on cards and dividers, never on type

elevation.shadow_style: soft diffused, warm-green tinted, never pure black
elevation.depth_cues: shadows plus overlapping sheets that echo the app's map-under-sheet composition

iconography.preferred_set: custom inline SVG matching the app's navigation glyphs

motion.entrance_pattern: one staggered hero reveal on load: phone, then headline lines, then CTA
motion.philosophy: minimal functional; motion confirms an action (download, expand, toggle) and never plays on scroll

components.button_style: coral filled pill with 3px darker bottom edge for primary actions, paper-on-hairline pill for secondary
components.input_style: not used on the marketing page; the app's white field with 8px radius is echoed in the demo panel
components.card_style: warm white sheet, 26px radius, 1px hairline, soft shadow, generous 32-40px padding
components.navigation_pattern: sticky single-row header with brand lockup, text links, version chip and a persistent download button
components.modal_style: none; disclosure uses native details/summary to stay keyboard and reader friendly
components.list_style: rows separated by hairlines with a leading glyph and a trailing metric, mirroring the app's place list
components.component_notes: The phone frame is the only chrome; screenshots sit inside it at their real 9:20 aspect.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: a folded paper map opened on a table, with one route drawn in coral
aesthetic.era_influence: contemporary cartography and Swiss transit signage

visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous; type is given room to act as the layout
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: heavy display type anchoring the left, imagery offset to the right
visual_language.texture_usage: flat paper tone, hairline rules, no gradients except the app's coral button

composition.flow_direction: left to right, top to bottom, with a single diagonal route line breaking the grid
composition.grouping_strategy: proximity and hairline separators rather than boxes around everything
composition.negative_space_role: frames the one route line and the phone, and lets the download action breathe

imagery.illustration_style: schematic street diagram drawn in SVG with the app's palette
imagery.graphic_elements: brand mark of three skewed bars, route lines, map pins, hairline grids
imagery.image_shape: screenshots clipped to a 9:20 rounded phone frame

interaction_feel.feedback_style: immediate, colour-led; buttons depress by 1px with their shadow removed
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: coral darkens, teal links underline, route lines brighten
interaction_feel.loading_style: none needed; the page is static

overview.fallback_strategy: disable transitions under prefers-reduced-motion; the animated route draws itself statically

background_effects.description: Flat paper with a faint hairline street grid clipped behind the hero only.

text_effects.description: Static type; the only motion is the hero's single load-in.

image_effects.description: Screenshots sit flat in their frame with a soft shadow.

svg_animations.description: The hero route line draws once from origin pin to destination pin on load.

visual_effects.composite_notes: The page stays a static sheet of paper. The single animated moment is the hero route drawing itself; everything else is hairline structure, a sticky glass header and the app's own coral button. The comparison panel is interactive but not animated decoratively: toggling Ride/Walk re-draws the two route paths and swaps two numbers, which is the product's own interaction.
